correctness.rationale: For r>=3,m>=3,F_{2^f}, the cycle shift S has B=S+S^{-1} acting as y^2/(1+y) on F[y]/y^{2^r}, giving exactly two size-L nilpotent Jordan blocks, L=2^{r-1}. The clique adjacency C=I+E is idempotent with eigenvalues 0 (1 copy) and 1 (m−1 copies) when m odd, whereas when m even it has one J2(1) plus m−2 scalar blocks. The Kronecker sum J_L(0)+J2(0) splits into two J_L blocks because L is a power of two, proven by c=a+b in F[a,b]/(a^L,b^2). A single adjacency J_L(beta) under two-row T has cyclic module F[X]/(X²+beta X+1)^L via a=X^{-1}(X²+beta X+1). GCD with X^t−1 gives the fixed-space exponents, and Möbius inversion gives exact least-period counts. Prime-factor checks show global orders 3*2^r versus 3*2^{r−1}. Independent exact GF(2) matrices and rank computations for r=3,m=3,4,5,6 reproduced orders 24/12 and all queried fixed-space ranks. These checks corroborate the unrestricted symbolic module proof, not replace it.
